verdict.rationale: Moneybird's docs describe self-serve sandbox administrations, separate from paid production accounts, built for testing API integrations with full feature access and watermarked invoices. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation that the MCP/CLI agent channels can target sandbox administrations, and details on resetting or seeding sandbox data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: We offer special sandbox administrations to test your API integration. These administrations grant full access to all our features without the need to subscribe to our services.
Sandbox accounts have limitations for production use: for example, invoices have watermarks.
